name: Coverage Type Validation — User Enters Invalid Option
goal: User attempts to type an invalid coverage type instead of selecting from widget; bot enforces widget selection.
constraints: User types an invalid option (e.g., 'Spouse Only') instead of selecting from widget.

result.message: You are eligible to book an appointment.

phases.description: Bot presents booking option; user chooses to book.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays eligibility message and quick reply for booking; user selects 'Book an appointment'.

phases.description: Bot asks for coverage type; user types 'Spouse Only' instead of selecting.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot re-renders widget, prompts user to select from widget again.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
